---
name: Credit correction
about: Report missing attribution, mistaken credit or an earlier solution to a Nilradical result.
title: "[Credit correction] Problem "
---

This issue is public. Please provide bibliographic evidence without posting
private correspondence or personal contact details. A human will review the
report; submission does not automatically establish attribution or priority.

## Affected result and revision

Give the problem number and a link to the affected record. Include the exact
source revision if available.

## Missing or mistaken credit

Describe the contributor, prior result or earlier solution that should be
considered, and which existing statement should change.

## Supporting sources

Give the author or contributors, title, stable URL or identifier, relevant
page or theorem, and public release date where known. Explain how the source
relates to the exact scope of the Nilradical result. Distinguish known dates
from dates that remain uncertain.

## Proposed correction

Suggest the attribution or wording you believe the record should use.
